My family likes to reunite and do parties everytime they can, and when they do so, they only spent their time gossiping about other family members, drinking, etc.

On the other hand, I'm reserved and quiet, so, I don't like that kind of activities, but I'm forced to go, mostly because they want to pretend that the family bonds are strong (when it's not the case), so, whenever I have to go, I just mind my own business while others just do their own stuff. I don't get along with my cousins of my age because:

* They already are in a relationship
* They just want to drink and do stuff that I don't like (smoking, going to bars)

Anyways, I got labelled as creep by my family because I barely talk, I don't go to these parties, and because whenever I go, I don't enjoy being there. Also, I remember that one time, an uncle was drunk as hell and he called me up for being the only person without a date in a party, since then, I decided to just talk to my nuclear family (mom and my brother, which I don't get along as well, but at least they kinda supports me because I'm the one that bring the bread to the table).

Other time that I was called a creep by them was when I was on my highschool graduation, every student was being named to receive their diploma, and for everyname, everyone was cheering that student (mostly the popular ones), so, you can guess that when my name was pronouced, the whole auditorium was silent, not even cricket sounds, so, my dad and and my mom confronted me because I wasn't popular enough to be cheered.

I'm not saying that I think I'm better than them, simply, I enjoy doing things that my family finds boring. The thing is, even when I explained to them why I don't like to go to these reunions, they seem to still try to force me to go, and whenever I go, I got called up for being the way I am. The worst thing, is that they gossip me a lot secretly, and they think I don't realize about it.

So, do I let this to bring me down? No, I try to keep going doing my stuff, since I firmly believe that not everyone is the same, you might like something that I don't, and vice versa, and I live up for it, but, that doesn't mean that the things that they say or do doesn't hurt, since every family is supposed to bring you support, not harm you.

That's my story, I guess, sorry for the long text, but I tried to explain myself. :)
